assets.name: Product / Clinical IP
assets.description: Algorithms, models, device design, proprietary know-how, technical differentiation, and clinically valuable intellectual property.

assets.name: Regulatory / Market Authorization
assets.description: FDA clearance or approval, other market authorizations, validated claims, quality evidence, and regulatory position supporting market access.

assets.name: Revenue / Customer Franchise
assets.description: Existing revenue, customers, contracts, installed base, procurement relationships, renewals, and commercial franchise.

assets.name: Clinical / Patient Data
assets.description: Clinical datasets, patient data under stewardship, training and evaluation datasets, measurements, images, and other valuable health data.

assets.name: Brand / Trust
assets.description: Trust and reputation with clinicians, patients, hospitals, regulators, partners, investors, and the market.

assets.name: Operations / Service Delivery
assets.description: Ability to manufacture, deploy, operate, support, maintain, and continuously deliver the product or clinical service.

assets.name: Safety
assets.description: Sustain safety of patients and medical staff

assets.name: Strategic / Enterprise Value
assets.description: Strategic partnerships, future pipeline, competitive position, platform value, growth options, and broader enterprise value not captured elsewhere.
